description: An animated, looping pan/zoom SVG scene composed from a provenance-verified prop kit (original MIT artwork, each asset pinned by sha256 and restricted to an allowlist of SVG elements). Give a preset and the layout, backdrop, props and motion come from it; or write the layout in full. Props are referenced by id and never as SVG, so the agent cannot introduce script or external references. For a one-off shape use agent_sketchpad; for a diagram use a chart or d2 atom.
